en: Color photo postcard showing a crowded sandy beach on a hot summer day. In the foreground a small child wearing a straw hat sits on the bow of a white rowboat beached at the shoreline (letters on the hull read "SR 6 CTA"). Many people sunbathe and play in the shallow water; low waves roll in. Far in the background are several modern high‑rise resort buildings. The reverse has Romanian text, a Romanian stamp, and a printed caption naming the resort Neptun.
